coordinates.note: This point is Williams Field (the specific launch strip named on ANITA's own campaign pages for the ANITA-II flight); the exact launch pad varied slightly by flight/year (LDB Camp vs Williams Field, both near McMurdo Station). The numeric coordinate itself comes from Wikipedia (rank 12); it is used here only for a campus-kind marker (per A17, geocoder/Wikipedia points are acceptable for campus|headquarters kinds), not as a precise detector position -- ANITA does not detect at this location anyway (see notes on detector:anita).

summary.plain: The icy airstrip near McMurdo Station, Antarctica, where giant NASA balloons carrying instruments like ANITA are launched.
summary.technical: NASA long-duration-balloon launch site (LDB Camp / Williams Field) near McMurdo Station, Antarctica, used for the ANITA balloon flights; a launch point, not a detection location.
